package.description: Lightweight TCP port monitoring alert tool for Windows.

en-US.description: Lightweight TCP port monitoring alert tool for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: PortAlert is a standalone lightweight monitoring tool for Windows that checks TCP ports in parallel using worker threads and sends alerts when monitored services become unavailable or recover. It is designed for small and middle business monitoring without a complex server setup.
en-US.name: PortAlert
